key_insight: Training language models on structured experimental evidence helped guide perovskite solar cell design, selecting a contact that delivered 27.05% efficiency.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-grounded AI could help engineers select materials and design discriminating experiments for more efficient, thermally stable perovskite devices.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 articles, linking experimental strategies, controls and observations to mechanisms.
Adapt OpenPerov using structured evidence; refine selected Pro responses with retrieved evidence.
Evaluate scientific reasoning with PSM-Bench and experimentally test a model-selected self-assembled monolayer contact.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; the experimentally selected K-analogue contact yielded devices retaining 96.74% of initial efficiency after 1,000 hours of dark thermal ageing at 85°C.
watch_item: The reported device validation concerns one contact-design test, and dark thermal ageing does not establish stability under operating illumination.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
